# 42. Trapping Rain Water

[LeetCode](https://leetcode.com/problems/trapping-rain-water/) · **Hard** · Pattern: [Two Pointers](README.md) · [All patterns](../README.md) · [Home](../../README.md)

> **Key insight:** Water at i = min(maxLeft, maxRight) - h; move the pointer on the lower side, whose max is final.

## Approach

1. Water at i = min(maxLeft, maxRight) - h; move the pointer on the lower side, whose max is final.
2. Complexity: time `O(n)`, space `O(1)`.

| | Complexity |
|---|---|
| Time | `O(n)` |
| Space | `O(1)` |

## Solution

<!-- prep:solutions:start -->
<details>
<summary><b>Python</b> (spoiler) · <code>0042-trapping-rain-water.py</code></summary>

```python
from typing import List


class Solution:
    def trap(self, height: List[int]) -> int:
        l, r = 0, len(height) - 1
        lmax = rmax = water = 0
        while l < r:
            if height[l] < height[r]:
                lmax = max(lmax, height[l])
                water += lmax - height[l]
                l += 1
            else:
                rmax = max(rmax, height[r])
                water += rmax - height[r]
                r -= 1
        return water
```

</details>
<!-- prep:solutions:end -->

- prefix/suffix max arrays first
